title: 第23章 舞月婵收心第24章 决裂
lines: “你这个该死的混蛋，快把月婵还给我！”
唐山的怒吼声在宫殿内回荡。
“哦？月婵？那是何人？”
顾云逗弄着小猫咪，逗得舞月婵喵叫不止，嘴角含笑看着唐山。
“你强闯皇宫，意图刺杀这帝国皇帝，我不过是路见不平、拔刀相助而已。”
舞月婵浑身都是痒痒的，沉浸在顾云的揉搓之中无法自拔。
“少在这里假惺惺的！”
唐山目眦欲裂：“你把那猫放下，我父亲要和你决一死战！”
唐日天：？？？
“他可是合体境的大能，就凭你也想在这里猖狂？”唐山得意开口。
但是顾云丝毫不在乎他的想法，而是手继续乱动。
他所触碰的就是舞月婵的本体，没有任何的阻碍。
“你找死！”唐山怒极攻心：“将那猫放下，兴许我还能饶你一命！”
说话间，唐山周身气势翻涌。
“神龙七十二斧！”
手中石斧高高举起，气势磅礴。
跟着父亲特训许久，唐山自信无比，加上有父亲压阵，他要亲手将舞月婵抢回来！
顾云眸子一凛，身上的气息猛地爆发而出，恐怖的修为宣泄而出。
瞬间将暴起的唐山摁在了地面之上，脸颊着地，动弹不得。
唐日天瞳孔骤缩。
“不可能，你只有炼虚境而已，为什么会有这么恐怖的威压？”
“没什么不可能的。”
“哼！你不要以为自己是什么上界的公子就可以兴风作浪，我唐家在上界也是丝毫不弱！”
唐日天冷哼一声，只能搬出先祖，试图将顾云唬住。
“唐家庄吗？”顾云忽然开口。
“你怎么会知道……不，哈哈，你知道就好！”唐日天的心情从惊讶到狂喜。
没想到老祖们的名气已经这般巨大了。
“我告诉你，你若是敢动我们父子两个，我唐家庄的先祖一定会将你的势力连根拔起，一个活口不留，你考虑清楚！”
看见两人得意洋洋的模样。
一道身影缓缓幻化而出。
唐日天的眸子微微眯起：“是你？！”
他从对方的身上感受到了之前背刺偷袭自己的相同气息。
“小子，将她交出来，我饶你一个全尸！”
唐日天狂傲开口。
下一秒。
一刀滑落。
人头落地。
唐山刚刚还嘴角含笑。
content_en:
"You damn bastard, give Yuechan back to me!"
Tangshan's roar echoed in the palace.
"Oh? Yuechan? Who is that?"
Gu Yun teased the kitten, making Wu Yuechan meow nonstop, looking at Tangshan with a smile on his face.
"You forced your way into the palace with the intention of assassinating the emperor of the empire. I just drew my sword to help you when you saw injustice."
Wu Yuechan's whole body was itchy, and she was immersed in Gu Yun's rubbing and couldn't extricate herself.
"Stop being so pretentious here!"
Tangshan's eyes were about to burst: "Put that cat down, my father will fight you to the death!"
Tang Ritian:? ? ?
"He is a powerful person in the Fusion Realm, but you still want to be rampant here?" Tang Shan said proudly.
But Gu Yun didn't care at all what he thought, and continued to move his hands randomly.
What he touched was Wu Yuechan's body, without any hindrance.
"You are looking for death!" Tangshan was furious: "Put that cat down, maybe I can spare your life!"
As he spoke, Tangshan's whole body surged with momentum.
"Seventy-two axes of Shenlong!"
The stone ax in his hand was raised high, with a majestic momentum.
After training with his father for a long time, Tangshan is extremely confident. With his father on his side, he wants to snatch Wu Yuechan back with his own hands!
Gu Yun's eyes froze, and the aura on his body suddenly burst out, and his terrifying cultivation level was released.
In an instant, Tang Shan was pressed to the ground, his face touching the ground, unable to move.
Tang Ritian's pupils shrank suddenly.
"Impossible, you are only in the Void Refining Realm, why do you have such terrifying pressure?"
"Nothing is impossible."
"Hmph! Don't think that just because you are a young master from the upper realm, you can make trouble. My Tang family is not weak at all in the upper realm!"
Tang Ritian snorted coldly and could only move out his ancestors and try to scare Gu Yun.
"Tangjiazhuang?" Gu Yun suddenly said.
"How did you know... No, haha, just know!" Tang Ritian's mood changed from surprise to ecstasy.
I didn’t expect that the ancestors’ fame would be so huge.
"Let me tell you, if you dare to touch us, father and son, my ancestors in Tangjiazhuang will definitely uproot your influence and leave no one alive. You need to think carefully!"
I saw the two of them looking triumphant.
A figure slowly transformed.
Tang Ritian's eyes narrowed slightly: "Is it you?!"
He felt the same aura from the opponent's body that stabbed him in the back before.
"Boy, hand her over and I'll spare you her whole body!"
Tang Ritian spoke arrogantly.
The next second.
The knife slipped.
Heads fell to the ground.
Tangshan had a smile just now.
